breadcrumb: Std 12 Political Science (English) — Unit 11: International Organisations — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: The International Telegraph Union (ITU) established in 1865 ... Universal Postal Union 1874 ... Hague Peace Conference 1899 ... Permanent Court of Arbitration 1902

en.q: In which year was the International Peace Conference held at The Hague?
en.explanation: The PCA began its work in 1902.

ta.q: ஹேக் நகரில் பன்னாட்டு அமைதி மாநாடு நடந்த ஆண்டு ______.

questions.quote: Following the surrender of Germany in 1945, representatives from fifty countries met in San Francisco on June 26, 1945 and signed the Charter ... UN officially came into existence on October 24, 1945

en.q: The United Nations officially came into existence on ______.
en.explanation: The Charter was signed in San Francisco on 26 June 1945 by representatives of 50 countries.

ta.q: ஐக்கிய நாடுகள் சபை அதிகாரபூர்வமாக உருவான நாள் ______.
ta.explanation: சாசனம் 1945 ஜூன் 26இல் சான் பிரான்சிஸ்கோவில் 50 நாடுகளால் கையெழுத்திடப்பட்டது.

questions.quote: General Assembly: 193 members, 1 country = 1 vote ... Security Council: 5 permanent members with veto, 10 non-permanent members elected for 2-year terms

en.q: How many member states does the UN General Assembly have, according to the textbook (and today)?
en.explanation: Each member has one vote regardless of size.

ta.q: பாடநூலின்படி (இன்றும்) ஐ.நா. பொதுச் சபையில் எத்தனை உறுப்பு நாடுகள் உள்ளன?
ta.explanation: அளவு எதுவாயினும் ஒவ்வொரு நாட்டுக்கும் ஒரு வாக்கு.

questions.quote: The Trusteeship Council became obsolete following the completion of the decolonization process ... General Assembly is the Parliament of the UN, the Security Council is its executive committee, the Secretariat is the bureaucracy

en.q: The textbook calls which UN organ the 'Parliament of the UN'?
en.explanation: The Security Council is described as its executive committee.

ta.q: பாடநூல் ஐ.நா.வின் எந்த அங்கத்தை 'ஐ.நா.வின் நாடாளுமன்றம்' என்கிறது?

questions.quote: ICJ in The Hague ... fifteen judges elected for nine year terms ... Peace Palace ... began functions in 1946

en.q: The International Court of Justice is located in ______.
en.explanation: It has fifteen judges elected for nine-year terms.

ta.explanation: இதில் ஒன்பது ஆண்டு பதவிக்காலம் கொண்ட பதினைந்து நீதிபதிகள் உள்ளனர்.

questions.quote: World Bank ... originally known as IBRD ... founded in 1945 ... based in Washington

en.q: The World Bank was originally known as the ______.
options: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
en.explanation: It is headquartered in Washington, D.C.

questions.quote: SCO formed in 2001 headquartered in Beijing ... Shanghai Five 1996 ... India and Pakistan became full members at the Astana summit in June 2017

en.q: India became a full member of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation in ______.
en.explanation: The SCO was formed in 2001, headquartered in Beijing; the book lists eight members (Iran has since joined, in 2023; Belarus joined in 2024, making 10 members).

ta.q: இந்தியா ஷாங்காய் ஒத்துழைப்பு அமைப்பில் முழு உறுப்பினரான ஆண்டு ______.
ta.explanation: SCO 2001இல் அமைக்கப்பட்டது, தலைமையகம் பெய்ஜிங்; பாடநூல் எட்டு உறுப்பினர்களைக் கூறுகிறது (2023இல் ஈரான் இணைந்தது; 2024இல் பெலாரஸ் இணைந்தது, 10 உறுப்பினர்கள்).
